digest.component_or_area: inbound parent reconciliation (fetcher, differ, fields, binding)
propositions: A parent removed in Jira (parent_id set to None) is never cleared in the local ticket because the fetcher omits absent-parent from the snapshot and the differ refuses to emit parent_id=None without peer evidence that Jira ever had the parent.

The differ's managed_refs gate cannot distinguish whether a ref was ever synced to Jira versus only created locally, causing false clears when a human set a parent directly in Jira without rebar ever pushing it.

The incident (change 1288) cleared 63 local parent edges by emitting parent_id=None based only on managed_refs; the same-pass outbound-write suppression never fires because the parent-set emit gate is disjoint from the parent-clear gate.

A fix requires positive evidence that the peer once carried the parent, persisted per-binding in the ADR-0026 baseline store and advanced only when a pass observes the parent key, to distinguish failed reads (safe degrade to {}) from genuine deletions.

The test oracle must measure three independent states: unobserved parent (key absent), observed parentless (key present and falsy), and unresolvable parent (key present but does not resolve), each with different clear semantics.
Rollout self-heals: on first pass after landing, no binding has recorded peer observations so nothing clears; observations accumulate as passes run and the feature becomes live per-binding.
